cypher_result.title: Animal welfare officer
cypher_result.description: When you work at the county board, you get to use your knowledge at the country's broadest authority. The county board is the state's representative in the county and ensures that national goals are achieved. Taking regional conditions into account, we make trade-offs between different societal interests. This is through collaboration between experts in a range of different fields and in collaboration with authorities, municipalities and organisations. At the county board, we create social benefit and influence social development, every day. It is an important assignment, a great responsibility and an inspiring opportunity. Let your knowledge become a force for Östergötland. We are looking for Östergötland is a vibrant agricultural county with extensive animal husbandry. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer to strengthen our unit. The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a 6-month trial period. Access as soon as possible and according to agreement. You will belong to the Animal Protection Unit, which has an expert function for the county board's assignments to operate throughout the food chain for healthy food, good animal welfare and protection of property and people in accordance with the Act on the Supervision of Dogs and Cats. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. The unit for animal protection is included together with the unit for food, veterinary and game, the unit for agricultural support and the unit for rural areas in the department for animals, rural areas and food. Your duties As an animal welfare officer, you work with animal welfare cases of various nature. You will work with both routine inspections of the farm's animals and complaint cases about lack of animal protection, permits for professional activities with horses or companion animals, as well as subsequent processing of any decisions. You may also be needed for other tasks at the unit, such as enforcement of custody orders. Depending on your skills and education, other tasks may also become relevant within the department for animals, rural areas and food such as animal control, area control, primary production control or the like. Required requirements for the position - You have at least a bachelor's degree in agronomy, ethology and animal welfare, biology, farm manager or other education that we deem relevant. - You have experience and good knowledge of several different animal species. - You have a good ability to express yourself in Swedish in speech and writing. - You have good knowledge of the agricultural industry. - You have previous experience of official work in animal welfare. - You have good knowledge of the Office package. - You have good knowledge of Platina. - You have good knowledge of the animal welfare control register. - You have a B driving licence. Meritorious for the position - Documented experience of working with farm animals. - Good knowledge of English. - Good knowledge of administration and confidentiality. As a person - Do you have high cooperation skills by working well with other people. You relate to them in a responsive and flexible way. You listen, communicate and resolve conflicts in a constructive way. - Are you service oriented in that you are calm, attentive and accommodating in your treatment. You have an interest, desire and ability to help others and make an effort to deliver solutions. - Are you structured in that you plan, organize and prioritize your work effectively. You set and keep time frames. - Are you stable in that you are calm and controlled in stressful situations or pressured situations. You maintain a realistic perspective on situations and focus on the right things. - You have a high ability for oral communication, this is because you will have a lot of contact with animal keepers and sometimes also with the media. This means that you speak clearly, articulately and engaged in individual meetings and in small and large groups. You listen and are receptive to the other party and adapt to the situation. About us as an authority, our benefits and other conditions Östergötland County Administrative Board is a state authority and our office is located in central Linköping. As employed by us, you have, among other things, wellness hours, wellness allowance, extended parental allowance and flexible working hours. We offer the option of remote work up to two days a week on average if the business allows. For us, it is important that our workplace is characterized by consideration, respect and communication and according to the state's core values. Read more about us, our benefits, our core values ​​and what it's like to work with us. https://www. the county board. see/ostergotland/about-us/work-with-us. htmlThe County Administrative Board has an important coordinating role in the event of social disturbances, and thus all employees are included in the crisis and war organization. Some of our services are security classified, which means that a security check will then be carried out before employment. If you want to know more, contact Head of Unit, Helen Loor, tel. 010-223 52 59. Union representative for SACO is Magnus Roback, tel. 010-223 54 89 and for ST is Nina Stenmark, tel. 010-223 53 04. Welcome with your application, which you send via www. which one. com. Your application must have been received no later than 2024-11-14, enter ref no: 17395.

cypher_result.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
cypher_result.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

cypher_result.title: Farm Veterinarian
cypher_result.description:
EPIROS SA, with a strong presence in the cheese industry and factories in Arta and Elassona, with a leading share in the Greek market and strong export activity, is looking for, on behalf of FARMA EPIROS:
Veterinarian
The position is full-time and will have the role of Scientific Manager for the Farms at Kampi Artas and Domokos Orchard.
 Purpose of the position:
The post holder is responsible for the primary care of a dairy goat or sheep (eg dystocia, C-sections, mastitis treatments) but in the overall supervision and guidance of the Farm Managers, in terms of animal nutrition, management births, the prevention of infectious and nutritional diseases, but also the wider hygiene of sheep and goats. 
Duties:

Creation and execution of vaccination plan.
Diagnosing diseases and determining the best treatment.
Ration monitoring and improvement suggestions.
Implementation and control of Farm procedures, related to the hygiene of sheep and goats.
Submission of proposals for the observance of the sanitary conditions of stables - livestock.
Recommendations to improve animal husbandry standards and/or unit procedures.

Necessary qualifications:

Veterinary Degree.
Professional License.
Minimum of 5 years of experience, preferably in sheep and goats.
Good knowledge of vaccination protocols.
Team spirit and effective communication skills.
Good knowledge of English language.
Good computer skills (MS Office, outlook).
Driver's license holder.
Possibility of travel within Greece, to our livestock units.

Provided:

Stable work environment.
Group insurance.
Training in modern sheep and goat management methods.
Development prospects.

Be part of our great team and send your CV!

We are now looking for an independent and responsible farm manager who wants to live on the farm and be an important part of our team in an inspiring and varied work environment. You will be the one who makes sure that everything from buildings and land to gardens, crops and deer fences are looked after in the best way. cypher_result.title: Kundansvarig till Biototal Group i Skåne
cypher_result.description: About Biototal GroupWithin Biototal Group, we work for sustainable solutions between city and country with the goal of utilizing all resources so they are useful in the cycle. Through our work, we see a clear improvement when it comes to increased fertility. cypher_result.title: Försökstekniker
cypher_result.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment.Scope:100% Access:Spring 2025, or as agreed.Application:Welcome with your application via the application button below by 2025-01-19 at the latest.Union contact persons:https://internt.slu.se/min -employment/union/contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

cypher_result.description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year. In between, meetings and contact take place via Teams and telephone. Collaboration and meetings with colleagues at the other cultural properties take place regularly, including in connection with joint property meetings twice a year. The members of the Vitterhetsakademie have a great interest in the cultural properties and many regularly visit Stensjö village. There is guest accommodation for them at each cultural property, which enables overnight stays.

cypher_result.title: Operations manager SLU Lanna Property
cypher_result.description: Do you want to become a key player for the future of crop cultivation in Sweden? As an operations manager at Lanna property, you have a unique opportunity to develop our operations in close proximity to research, experiments and students. We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. cypher_result.description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for prisons, probation, custody and client transport. Do you want to know more? Hear what our employees think about working within the Correctional Service: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/We are now looking for a new colleague for Svartsjö agriculture, which belongs to the Stockholm West business area, located in Ekerö municipality. It is possible to get to work via both the south and west side of Stockholm. About 170 employees and ten managers manage, lead and develop the business, which receives approx. 270 inmates. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. We get around 75 calves per season and have around 160 animals in total. The machinery park is modern with GPS technology and a workshop for service. The business also includes firewood production, vegetable growing, green area maintenance and carpentry. There are well-equipped staff areas with gyms and charging stations. JOB DUTIES As a production manager/operations manager, you get a central and inspiring role where you are primarily responsible for the animals together with three colleagues. During the crop growing season, you broaden your role and collaborate with the team on the crop growing side, which includes more other colleagues. The daily work is carried out by the institution's inmates, and you become an important role model who, with your commitment, motivates and guides them in their working life. You will have a workforce of approx. 10-15 clients depending on the season. Here you have the chance to influence and make a difference to contribute to the Correctional Service's vision Better out. The role is both diverse and eventful, and it requires good basic physics because the tasks are often physically demanding. Here you get the opportunity to work hands-on and develop together with committed colleagues all while making a real difference. Working as a production manager means that you contribute to a better society. In order to enjoy and succeed in your assignment, it is important that you share the Prison Service's basic values ​​of a humane view of people, respect for the individual and the belief that people can be developed. has practical experience and a strong interest in work management in animal husbandry and crop cultivation. As a production manager, you have clear and pedagogical insight into how best to introduce and supervise inmates from the institution, while actively participating in the tasks yourself. You are also welcome to apply for the position if you are only interested in working with the animals. We have the opportunity to send staff on training courses that are relevant to being able to cope with the tasks, in addition to this, we have a solid individual introduction. cypher_result.title: Tractor and machine operator for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
cypher_result.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. The growing season with us runs roughly between 1 April- 15 November and as a machine operator with us, during this period you are basically all the time in a tractor in a field to help the crops reach their full potential. At other times of the year, it is service and maintenance of the machinery in the workshop, improvements to outbuildings, trucking and transport between our various warehouses. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you have warmed up in the clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience driving agricultural machines, that you can drive them skillfully without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your part the best is a matter of course. You are welcome to describe yourself as driven, humorous, in a good mood even if you are busy and that you have your heart in the relationship with colleagues, products and partners. The position is a full-time position all year round. the application is positive. The position can be filled before the application deadline. Entry date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look today but no later than 15 March 2025. Salary according to increase. For the right applicant who does not currently live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

cypher_result.title: Växa is looking for an Expert in sustainability
cypher_result.description: Väx's department for Knowledge & Development strives for a very high level of competence in the most important subject areas linked to milk and beef production. We play an important role by monitoring research results and making them available to the Swedish agricultural companies in the form of services and tools. We also carry out assignments and investigations for authorities, food companies and other actors in the food chain. Our development department also carries out its own projects, both in collaboration with researchers and more applied at the farm level. Our work contributes to the development of Swedish agriculture by providing a varied and innovative range of services that provide increased profitability and productivity, good animal health and a reduced climate footprint.Knowledge & Development is now strengthening the team for Sustainability and is looking for an expert with competence in the field, preferably with special interest in forage and crop cultivation. Our new expert will step up for colleagues in several of our ongoing projects, where we support various companies and organizations within the agricultural and food industry in their sustainability work. You will thus have a key role in ensuring our future level of competence and contribute to meeting the increased demand for specialist competence in the area of ​​sustainability. Our new expert will work together with existing colleagues to create the conditions for profitable and sustainable agriculture. In your assignment as an Expert in sustainability at Växa, you will, among other things: Initiate, lead and participate in projects, mainly in the area of ​​sustainability Collaborate with, and carry out assignments for, industrial customers, universities, authorities and industry organizations Monitor and compile research in various areas of sustainability linked to , e.g. climate impact from plant cultivation and feed supply, soil health, biological diversity and carbon storage Conduct environmental monitoring and competitive analysis Convey knowledge internally and externally Together in Växas' sustainability team develop the internal and external sustainability work Together with other departments, develop the range of services and tools As the current position is newly established, you will have great opportunities to shape the position based on your knowledge and your way of working. To fit the role, we want you to: Have an academic degree in a relevant field ; e.g. agronomist or equivalent Has at least 3 years of work experience in a relevant field Has knowledge in climate impact from agriculture, preferably with a focus on crop cultivation and/or fodder supply Has a good command of Swedish and English both verbally and in writing It is further meritorious if you: Have knowledge in soil health, carbon storage and biological diversity Has knowledge in LCA Has knowledge in climate calculations Has previous work experience from work as a consultant or equivalent Has experience of practical work on a farm with milk or beef production Have a PhD in a relevant field We attach great importance to your personal qualities such as your own drive and initiative. We believe that you find it easy to collaborate with colleagues who have many different skills and perspectives, as well as that you are development-oriented, solution-oriented and business-minded.Scope and place of placement Full-time and permanent with placement at one of Växas' operating locations. The position involves a number of travel days per year in Sweden and abroad. Salary according to agreement. For more information, please contact Head of Sustainability Malin Hidgård, malin.hidgard@vxa.se 073-073 31 27 Union contact person: Jessica Stenvall, jessica.stenvall@vxa.se 070-269 29 15 Application no later than 2024-11 -15 Interviews may take place continuously and the position may be filled before the last one application day. Welcome with your application!

The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. jobs.description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use.
